scope: Exact parameterized helper and eight injected-reader fixture cases; no fresh live Kubernetes or prior-failed-run acceptance.
limits: Polling budget depends on the read callback honoring its request timeout; it is not a hard process or callback deadline.
Direct Ready-true, validator refusal and receipt-I/O failures are not separately exercised by these eight cases.
Private acceptance wrapper wiring is source-checked and pinned; it was not executed against a cluster.
